trust_decision.summary: Which browser origins the local configserver (GraphQL config/secrets API plus logs API) answers is decided only by the engine-wide CORS middleware in serve(); the GraphQL auth directives are no-op stubs, and secrets are loaded in full into the in-memory store that every resolver reads from.

landing_point.why: The summary says 'cross-origin unauthenticated'. `cors.Default()` (allow-all origins) is the only origin control on the configserver router, so this is the first place to look.

fix_sites.entry_point: HTTP POST /v1/configserver/graphql and /v1/logs/graphql (engine-wide middleware), started by hidden CLI `nhost configserver`
public Go API oapimw.CORS(CORSOptions) (shared with services/auth and services/storage); new AllowOriginFunc
GetApps loader at configserver startup; feeds GraphQL appSecrets/appsSecrets/config(resolve)/configRawJSON(resolve)/runServiceConfig(resolve)
GraphQL mutations insertSecret/updateSecret/deleteSecret -> plugin UpdateSecrets (persist to .secrets)
GraphQL queries/mutations keyed by appID (was fixed zero UUID)
CLI `nhost dev up` (creates .nhost/app_id via new cli/clienv/appid.go, fix.diff:43-69)
CLI `nhost dev cloud` (passes proj.GetID() as app ID)
compose generation for `nhost dev up`/`cloud` (NHOST_APP_ID env)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: cli/cmd/configserver/local.go:164-180 (UpdateSecrets writes newApp.Secrets back to .secrets). Once the loader redacts, this path must merge placeholders with the on-disk values (fix.diff:340-369). Second out-of-scope site: the shared lower-level CORS library internal/lib/oapi/middleware/cors.go:87-92, which had no predicate-based origin option.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The report is about cross-origin access, so a solver sees restricting CORS in serve() as the complete fix: secret redaction in the loader and the save-path merge look like a separate 'secrets at rest' hardening, and the shared oapi CORS lib (used by auth/storage) looks like another product's code.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: The local dashboard at https://local.dashboard.local.nhost.run[:port], <sub>.dashboard.local.nhost.run and local.dashboard.nhost.run must keep making credentialed cross-origin GraphQL calls. Its updateSecret/insertSecret/deleteSecret mutations send the whole secrets list back, so a secret that comes back as the placeholder must keep its real on-disk value rather than being overwritten. Deny-all CORS or refusing placeholder-valued writes would break the dashboard.

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The logs GraphQL websocket on the same configserver process has its own origin check, which accepts any http://localhost or 127.0.0.1 port and multi-label *.dashboard.local.nhost.run origins. That is looser than the new CORS regex, and the fix did not touch it.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: It already has a deliberate, commented origin check. It serves container logs, not configuration or secrets. And the advisory's own test rejects http://localhost:3000 only for CORS (fix.diff:230).

O8_uncovered_routes.route: The fix randomises the app ID, but list queries that need no appID (configs, appsSecrets) return it, and their @hasRole guard is the no-op dummyMiddleware2. A same-origin or allowed caller can enumerate the ID.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The app ID is not meant to be a secret, CORS is the real gate, and the schema is vendored upstream code.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: Add a gqlgen multipart/form transport (or a REST import endpoint) on the configserver or logs router. It accepts CORS-safelisted content types, so a cross-origin write reaches the plugin without a preflight even with the new CORS.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Maintainers add multipart transports for uploads and import endpoints routinely. The mimir POST transport only accepts application/json (vendor/github.com/99designs/gqlgen/graphql/handler/transport/http_post.go:31-41), and that is what makes CORS sufficient today.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A run-service config persist path that writes resolved or secret-bearing env values back to disk, needing the same placeholder merge as UpdateSecrets.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: UpdateRunServiceConfig is the parallel persist path in the same plugin. Run-service env values can carry secrets, and a maintainer adding redaction would naturally cover only .secrets.
